Naya the Secretive

Overview

Naya is Estera’s apprentice and has long hunted on her teacher’s behalf. Estera offers her help to Zak as a test of her training. Naya wants her abilities respected and hopes one day to succeed Estera and teach an apprentice of her own. [1, 2, 3]

Recruitment and farewell

Estera introduces Naya as her apprentice and offers her assistance as a test of her training. Naya corrects the impression that she lacks experience: she already hunts for the witch and has faced goblins and orcs. If recruited, she travels as a capable assistant rather than an untrained dependent. At parting she hopes to succeed Estera and teach an apprentice of her own. Her cryptic farewell hints at a change awaiting Zak, but she refuses to explain what she sees. [1, 2, 3, 4]
